hints.content: Function $\redD g$ is not flipped vertically compared to $\blueD f$, so does not have a negative coefficient.
Function $\redD g$ is stretched vertically relative to  $\blueD f$, so must be multiplied by a number with a magnitude greater than $1$.

question.content:
$\redD g$ is a transformation of $\blueD f$. The graph below shows $\blueD f$ as a solid blue line and $\redD g$ as a dotted red line.

[[☃ image 1]]

** What is the formula of $\redD g$ in terms of $\blueD f$? **

[[☃ radio 1]]

options.alt: A cubic graph f and its transformed graph g are on an x y coordinate plane. The x- and y- axes scale by one. Graph f is concave down from negative infinity to negative two. It is concave up from negative two to infinity. It passes through point (negative six, four) and (one, one). Graph g concave down from negative infinity to negative two. It is concave up from negative two to infinity. It passes through point (negative six, eight) and (one, two).
